title: Investigation report on Google Photos backup failure for HEIC images
body:
I investigated why Google Photos failed to back up IMG_6009 and IMG_6010 while successfully backing up IMG_6008. 

My analysis revealed a key hardware difference: the working photo was taken with the Ultra Wide camera, whereas the failing ones used the Wide (Main) camera. These camera modes generate different metadata structures and MakerNotes. I also verified the structural integrity of all three HEIF containers and found no corruption. 

The most likely causes are either a server-side deduplication error or an incompatibility in Google Photos' parser for the specific metadata produced by the Wide sensor on this iPhone model.

The full report is available in `iPhone photos that Google Photos refuses to back up/findings_report.md`, along with the diagnostic scripts and structural dumps used for the investigation.

Fixes #16
